thread:
samir: Heads-up: onboarding playbook draft ready for review. Focus: cert gating, hw loaner billing, and joint-announcement timing. Need feedback on the flow & marketplace intake fields.
elaine: Nice. Quick ask: can cert issuance be automated on Bronze/Silver? We want immediate badge plumbing for self-serve partners. Gold requires legal/SE signoff.
rafi: Auto-issue Bronze if infra-lab tasks pass and telemetry tags present. Silver should require a 30m live walkthrough with an SE. Gold = pilot + SLA signed + reference.
toni: For HW loans: propose billing rule: partners pay shipping + refundable deposit. If damage reported, charge repair fees. Need SKU mapping and max loan window. hw-logistics: can we enforce 14-day loan and track via loan_id?
hw-logistics: yes. We'll issue loan_id like LOAN-<vendor>-<seq>. Enforce 14d default, can extend once after review. We'll add damage-deposit field to intake.
samir: Marketplace intake fields I propose: partner_id, cert_track (bronze|silver|gold), requires_hw_loan (bool), loan_id (opt), nda_signed, wants_joint_announcement (enum: none|blog|press|co-webinar), embargo_date (opt). Also telemetry tags: si_cohort, hw_loan_id, cert_level.
elaine: Add "public_badge_visible" flag so Bronze can be internal-only. Also add "co_marketing_contact" and "preferred_announce_window" (ISO date).
rafi: Approval flow pseudo-YAML:
```yaml
cert_approval_flow:
  bronze:
    prerequisites: [labs_auto_pass, telemetry_present]
    issue: automated
  silver:
    prerequisites: [bronze, live_walkthrough_minutes:30]
    issue: semi-automated (SE approves)
  gold:
    prerequisites: [silver, pilot_sla_signed, reference_confirmed]
    issue: manual (partnerships+legal)
```
toni: On joint announcements: legal needs 10 business days for quote/asset approvals. Marketing needs 2 weeks for blog + 4 weeks to schedule webinar. So timeline must be surfaced in intake UI and PR.
samir: For embargo handling, intake should capture embargo_date and "embargo_required" bool. If embargo_required true, auto-route to legal and marketing with 10-day SLA. marketplace-bot: Created task REDWOOD-SI-5555 "Marketplace intake: cert & announcement fields" -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REDWOOD-SI-5555
elaine: Can we add a microbadge system? e.g., "Routing-Expert", "Private-Install", "Performance-Tuned". Badges auto-awarded on task completion. Badges should appear on partner profile and be filterable in marketplace.
rafi: Good idea. We need mapping: each microbadge = list of checks + optional artifact (logs, video). Example: Performance-Tuned = [dedicated_scale_test pass, perf_report_artifact].
toni: For HW compatibility matrix, include minimum driver versions and recommended SKUs. Also mark which SKUs are loan-eligible. hw-logistics: we'll publish a spreadsheet with SKU, memory, nvlink, loanable bool.
hw-logistics: publishing ETA: EOD Thu. We'll include shipping rules and insurance requirements.
samir: Security note: if telemetry is off for air-gapped partners, cert issuance must include signed manifests or recorded acceptance. Add intake flag "airgap_mode" and required evidence list.
elaine: We should also automate badge issuance via an endpoint. Example: POST /partners/<id>/badges with payload {badge_id, evidence_urls}. SE can trigger after walkthrough. Include a signed JWT from SE to prevent spoofing.
rafi: Example curl:```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/partners/1234/badges" -H "Authorization: Bearer $SE_TOKEN" -d '{"badge_id":"routing-expert","evidence":["https://.../perf.pdf"]}'
```
toni: Action items: 1) hw-logistics publish SKU matrix by Thu; 2) Samir open intake PR to add fields (due Fri); 3) Rafi draft microbadge rules + evidence catalog (Mon); 4) Elaine coordinate legal/marketing SLA for announcements (Mon). marketplace-bot: Card updated REDWOOD-SI-5555 -> fields set + assignees.
hw-logistics: Noted. We'll include loan_id generation and deposit workflow.
samir: Let's pilot this with 3 SIs next month (two marketplace-first, one dedicated pilot). If pilot goes well we flip public flag in 2 weeks post-pilot.
elaine: One more: telemetry tags for billing + referral credits. Add "referral_code" and "launch_concierge_version" to listings. Helps revenue ops.
rafi: Solid. I'll start wiring the auto-issue Bronze job to the badge service. Keep the live-walkthrough checklist skinny (5 checks).
toni: Thanks all. We'll reconvene after hw matrix is posted. :rocket:
